title: Patch: equip a newly earned cosmetic straight from the pack-opening reveal
thread:
**Issue #1955 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1955: Patch: equip a newly earned cosmetic straight from the pack-opening reveal
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

When a pack opening grants a cosmetic the account did not own, the player can only reach it through the link "See and equip your cosmetics in your Collection" (`apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, `shopTestid.equipLink`), and the card-pack scene (`apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`) offers nothing at all. Give every revealed slot whose grant is a **new cosmetic** an **Equip** button, so the player can wear it right away without leaving the opening.

Both scenes get it:

- **Card packs** (`PackScene` in `packs/PackOpening.tsx`): a slot with `grant.kind === "cosmetic"` (R1301002, R1827000, R1833000). Shown only once that slot is revealed (after its flip, or at once under reduced motion or skip-all).
- **Cosmetic packs** (`shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`): a slot with `grant.kind === "cosmetic"` (R1306000, R1306001).

What Equip writes is exactly what the Collection's pickers write today, so nothing new is stored and no request is made (CLAUDE.md rule 7: the server already settled the grant; the client only records the viewer's pick, as the Collection does):

| The cosmetic's kind (from `COSMETICS`, `wire/generated/cosmetics.ts`) | Equip does | Same as |
|---|---|---|
| `foil`, `finish`, `border` (per-card) | `writeCardPick(cardId, kind, id)` on the card it was granted on (card pack: `slot.cardId`; cosmetic pack: `grant.cardId`) | `CardCosmeticsView.tsx`'s `equip` |
| `fullArt` (per-card) | `writeCardFullArt(cardId, true)` | `CardCosmeticsView.tsx` |
| `table`, `field`, `cardBack` (account) | `writeCosmetics({ [kind]: id })` | `AccountCosmeticTiles.tsx` |
| `portrait` | **no button**: a portrait is a deck's pick (R641, R1827000), so the slot keeps today's words and the Collection link stays | — |

After a press the button reads **Equipped** and is disabled; if the store already holds that pick (it was equipped before the reveal) it shows Equipped from the start. Keep the existing Collection link (`equipLink`) as it is.

**Ownership gotcha.** Ownership is read once per session from `GET /api/cosmetics` and cached (`cards/ownedFullArt.ts`, `ViewerFullArt` / `ViewerAccountCosmetics`, R1313000, R1655000, R1833000). A pick of something the cache does not list is worn as its kind's default, so equipping the new cosmetic would silently show nothing until a reload. After a successful open, drop and re-read that cache (`forgetOwnedCosmetics()` plus whatever re-mount or re-read `ownedFullArt.ts` needs) so the new cosmetic counts as owned on this session's boards, inspect previews and Collection. Do not mark it owned on the client from the opening's answer; the re-read is what decides.

**Spec.** R1579000 says the Collection is "the one place a cosmetic is equipped… a screen that wants one links to Cosmetics". This amends it: add a ruling note in this issue's block (lowest free in R(N×1000)…, `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers) saying a pack opening's reveal may equip the cosmetic it just granted, writing the same stores as the Collection, portraits excepted, and that a deck's own pick still beats an account pick (R1297000). Edit R1579000's text (and §14.2 / §14.6 in `spec/14-economy.md` if they repeat the "one place" rule) to point at the new note, then `cargo jackioh spec index`.

Words go through `t()` (`Equip`, `Equipped`) with their i18n entries; test ids go in `packs/packs.ts`'s and `shop/shop.ts`'s testid maps. Client only: no server, engine, catalog or card change.

Related: #1953 (open) also touches the cosmetic-pack panel ("cosmetic tokens spent in place"); not a blocker, but merge main before building if it lands first.

## Acceptance

- `PackOpening.test.tsx`: a card-pack slot granting a per-card cosmetic shows Equip only after it is revealed; pressing it writes `writeCardPick` (or `writeCardFullArt` for a full art) for that slot's card, and the button then reads Equipped and is disabled.
- `PackOpening.test.tsx`: a slot granting an account cosmetic (`table`, `field` or `cardBack`) writes the `cosmetics` group's key for that kind; a `portrait` grant shows no Equip button; a `card` or `bars` slot shows none.
- `Shop.test.tsx` (or `CosmeticPacks` tests): the same three cases for a cosmetic-pack slot, using `grant.cardId` for a per-card cosmetic, and the Collection link is still there.
- A test that after a successful open the owned-cosmetics cache is re-read, so a just-equipped cosmetic is worn (not its default) by the viewer's card or side without a reload.
- A slot whose cosmetic is already the store's pick shows Equipped on reveal.
- Reduced motion and skip-all show the buttons with the results at once.
- The new ruling note exists with a test named after it (CLAUDE.md rule 3), R1579000 points to it, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` pass.

## Blocked by, part of

None.
```
